title: CommunityEconomicsRecord
description: Schema contract for local household economic indicators collected via Bright Data

geography_id.description: FIPS code, NUTS code, or standardized geographic identifier

geography_name.description: Human readable name of county, municipality, or district

region.description: State, province, or primary administrative unit

median_household_income.description: Annual median household income in USD or localized currency equivalent

income_growth_pct_12m.description: 12-month percentage growth in median household income
